title: Rigidity of multisections to the universal cubic plane curve
summary: We study the following question of Farb: For which positive integers n is it possible to choose n distinct points continuously on every smooth cubic plane curve? This paper is a continuation of the work of Banerjee-Chen. We prove that such choice is unique up to homotopy for n=27 (smallest open case), and does not exist for n=36k+18.
